title: Page 307
transc:
SH Beckwith  Washn D. C. Dec 13th 1863
Grapes Forlorn Dec Henrietta For Japan Bridle Zebra 
We have heard no thing from Lonesome for
some days Unity Garden papers of yesterday say
that Hoax is preparing to hold Rutledge that
his Pacific passed through Pound Sharper and penetrated
Aurora to Mount Sterling burning that place and
Piloting money & supplies and that Biped is
weighed Zodiac If this be true and Hotel
is establishing him self in Ripley Adonis will
it not be unsafe to with draw Kidnap's
Saints till the Rome is driven out of
the state Star The holding of Richland Adonis
and of preventing the Ridge from getting
supplies there is deemed of the greatest
importance Zebra Please give this suggestion your
care - ful at = tent = tion <insertion>(shun)</insertion> zodiac More
over as Kindles Operations have failed to
produce any results Happy may send by
Welch Weaknesses to Hotel with out our
knowing it This contingency must al so
be considered Yoke Ireland mighty fine day
